verdict.rationale: Webhook subscriptions are a fair question for a virtual-mailbox SaaS with an API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a gated, undocumented API, a Zapier integration, and real-time email alerts. None of these are documented, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks, so the product gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
